breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt gave a conflicting instruction to use both a 'gamma-centered k-point grid' and a 'Monkhorst-Pack grid with a half shift'. These are mutually exclusive. The ground truth resolved this by removing the 'half shift' instruction. The generated specification correctly follows this by stating 'Use a gamma-centered Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid', thus dropping the contradictory 'half shift' part and resolving the conflict.
